resources.string: "PILOT • Payments and crypto transfers are disabled. Real proxy sharing starts only after explicit consent."
"PILOT: Real third-party traffic can use this device’s connection and IP address. Use only a device and connection you own or are authorized to share. You can stop at any time."
"Pilot only: the key is used in memory by SDK 1.3.2, is cleared from this field and is not compiled into or saved by MARS-X."
"Accept both Network consent and the Proxies.sx disclosure before starting."
"Enter the SDK API key created in your Proxies.sx farmer account."
"This will start the Proxies.sx foreground service and may route eligible customer traffic through this device. Traffic and earnings are not guaranteed. Continue only on your own authorized device."
"Notification permission is required so active sharing remains visible."
